objective: Find why Gallowspire's dead have begun losing their names.

world.weather: Cold rain under a bruised violet sky

inventory.name: Morcant Iron Sabre
inventory.details: 1d8 cutting. Iron edge interferes with manifested spirits.

inventory.name: Hooded Salt Lantern
inventory.details: Burns whale oil through a salt-treated wick. Reveals some boundary marks.

inventory.name: Waxed Road Coat
inventory.details: Armor 2. Rainproof enough to make the coast merely miserable.

inventory.name: Blackglass Memory Token
inventory.details: Warm when held. Contains the last visual memory of a murdered courier.

inventory.name: Boundary Salt
inventory.details: Enough for one doorway, a small grave, or a very optimistic campsite.

inventory.name: Hardbread & Smoked Eel
inventory.details: One day's ration if you do not think too hard about the eel.

quests.title: The Black Tithe
quests.summary: Three corpses in Gallowspire have become impossible for their families to remember by name.

stages.title: Examine the nameless dead
stages.description: Meet Undertaker Pell beneath Saint Orra's hospital.

stages.title: Compare the death rolls
stages.description: Find who altered the Synod burial ledger.

quests.title: A Courier's Last Sight
quests.summary: Identify the place trapped inside the blackglass token.

stages.title: Decode the reflected sigil
stages.description: Find someone who can read Threnody without touching the token.

journal.title: Rain over Gallowspire
journal.body: Prelate Venn paid half in advance and lied twice before I finished the tea. Three families remember burying someone, but not who. The undertaker still knows the names. For now.

memories.summary: Prelate Ysra Venn hired Rook to investigate three nameless corpses and is frightened of Synod superiors learning how serious the problem is.
Rook carries a blackglass token containing a murdered courier's last visual memory. A mirrored Threnody sigil appears inside it.

milestones.title: A Name Kept
milestones.description: Preserve a person's true name when the world tries to erase it.
milestones.reward: +1 permanent Resolve and a unique memory trait

milestones.title: The Road Remembers
milestones.description: Visit five distinct regions of Mournreach.
milestones.reward: Wayfarer's instinct: advantage on the first travel check in a region

milestones.title: Tongue of Graves
milestones.reward: Speak directly to certain echoes without a ritual intermediary

npcs.name: Ysra Venn
npcs.title: Prelate of the Seventh Lantern
memory: Withheld at least one detail about the first corpse.

npcs.name: Orren Pell
npcs.title: Undertaker of Saint Orra
memory: Reportedly remembers all three erased names.

npcs.name: Mara Silt
npcs.title: Salt Witch ferrier
memory: Rook once returned a memory bead without opening it.

factions.name: The Lantern Synod
factions.publicGoal: Keep the dead buried and miracle-work controlled.
factions.knownSecret: Prelate Venn believes the current case could embarrass senior clergy.

factions.name: The Salt Witches
factions.publicGoal: Keep old boundaries and old bargains.

locations.name: Gallowspire
locations.state: Rain-locked port city under Synod curfew.

locations.name: Greywake
locations.state: Ferry village and Salt Witch crossing.

locations.name: Mirecross
locations.state: Market town built on seven generations of stilts.

locations.name: Ashmarket
locations.state: Salvage city around an exposed imperial forum.

rumors.text: A bell can be heard beneath Saint Orra's hospital on nights when no funerals are scheduled.
House Morcant is paying double for intact imperial road markers.
Salt Witches have begun refusing memory beads minted after midsummer.

logs.title: The Black Tithe
logs.body: Rain combs the slate roofs of Gallowspire. Beneath Saint Orra's hospital, Undertaker Pell is waiting beside three bodies whose families can no longer say whom they buried. Somewhere below the city, very faintly, metal answers metal.
